# Quill

> The note that writes itself from your voice.

Quill is a mobile AI note-taking app (currently in closed beta) for people who
think out loud: students, researchers, writers, and professionals. Speak
freely and Quill titles, structures and remembers, turning a few minutes of
rambling into a clean note with flashcards for review.

## What Quill does

- Voice capture: record yourself talking. Quill transcribes, structures, and
  titles the note. No editing required.
- Text capture: type, paste, or drop in raw text, meeting notes, or a URL.
  Quill returns a clean, searchable note in seconds.
- Document import: upload PDFs. Quill extracts the key ideas and turns them
  into notes and flashcards.
- Built-in recall: every note becomes flashcards automatically. No separate
  study step.

## How it works

1. Capture: speak, type, or upload. However a thought arrives, Quill accepts
   it without friction.
2. Curate: Quill structures the input into a clean, titled note with a summary
   and key points. This usually takes 10 to 30 seconds.
3. Study: flashcards are generated as you go. Review is built in, not bolted on.

## Status and access

- Quill is in closed beta. Early access is now open via the waitlist.
- Joining the waitlist asks for full name, email, role, and an explicit
  consent checkbox. Details are used for early access contact only. No spam.
- Contact: helloasharaamer@gmail.com
- Privacy policy: #privacy on the homepage.
